concerns.text: The plan states that Pearson correlations will be computed (e.g., "compute Pearson correlations"), but the `contracts/analysis_output.schema.yaml` defines the field `correlation_rho` as a *Spearman* rank correlation coefficient. This creates a mismatch between the statistical method described in the plan and the contract schema expecting Spearman.

Principle II (Verified Accuracy) of the constitution requires every external citation to be verified. The plan’s Constitution Check marks Principle II as compliant while noting that OpenML and Last.fm references are “flagged as unavailable”. Unavailable citations are not verified, thus the plan violates Principle II.

The plan does not explicitly reference any of the defined contracts (e.g., `contracts/merged_dataset.schema.yaml`, `contracts/analysis_results.schema.yaml`, `contracts/analysis_output.schema.yaml`). Consequently, no plan element can be shown to exercise these contracts, breaching the cross‑document rule that every contract must be exercised by at least one plan step.
